clue.text: Capital doubled for single person, we hear

indicators.note: we hear tells us the clue words are to be taken as they sound when spoken

parts.note: a single person is a soul (as in 'not a soul'), and single also suggests sole

explanation.surface: A capital city has been made a double for a lone individual, so rumour has it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'doubled' hints that the capital sounds like two words for 'single person': SOLE (single) and SOUL (person).
explanation.definitionFit: Seoul is the capital city of South Korea.

clue.text: One way to cook Cathy's ingredients in vessel

parts.note: steaming is a cooking method

indicators.note: ingredients are components mixed together, so the letters of Cathy are rearranged

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: Cathy steams her ingredients in a pot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'vessel' looks like a cooking pot, but it is the boat.
explanation.definitionFit: A steam yacht is a boat powered by steam, so a kind of vessel.

clue.text: I was the first to be heard

indicators.note: to be heard tells us the words are taken as they sound when spoken

parts.note: to come first in a race is to have won

explanation.surface: Someone boasts of being the first person to be heard.
explanation.definitionFit: I is the Roman numeral for one.

clue.text: Allowed to go, i.e. fired

definitions.meaning: excused or released from a penalty
discharged, as a gun or firework

explanation.surface: Someone was dismissed, that is, sacked.
explanation.definitionFit: Let off means excused from punishment and also discharged, as a gun is fired.

clue.text: Male ordered article, not in good faith?

parts.note: he is the male pronoun

indicators.note: ordered means arranged, so the letters of article are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A man has sorted out a newspaper piece that shows bad faith.
explanation.definitionFit: A heretical belief departs from orthodox religious faith, wittily described as not being in good faith.

clue.text: For a shire you could resort to this .

definitions.text: For a shire you could resort to this

indicators.note: re-sort means sort again, so the letters of for a shire are rearranged

explanation.surface: This is where to go if you need a shire.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resort' looks like a holiday place but means re-sort, the letters reshuffled; a shire is a large carthorse sold at such a fair.
explanation.definitionFit: A horse fair is a market for buying horses such as the heavy Shire breed.

clue.text: Regretted keeping the pound, one's decided

indicators.note: keeping means holding, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: rued means regretted
L is the abbreviation for pound sterling, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: Someone sorry for having kept the pound has made up their mind.
explanation.definitionFit: To have ruled on a matter is to have decided it.

clue.text: Leaves for this afternoon meeting

parts.note: leaves read as tea leaves, used for an afternoon social gathering, not departs

explanation.surface: Someone sets off this afternoon for a meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: This is an afternoon social occasion where tea, brewed from leaves, is served.

clue.text: Smart,'understanding, and paid very little money

parts.note: chic means stylish or smart
ken is knowledge or understanding
fee'd, given a fee, so paid

explanation.surface: A smart and wise worker was paid a pittance.
explanation.definitionFit: Chicken feed is an idiom for a trivially small sum of money.

clue.text: Box made from piece of wood given fine finish

parts.note: a log is a piece of wood

indicators.note: finish points to the end letter of fine

explanation.surface: A box is made from a block of wood with a good finish.
explanation.definitionFit: A loge is a box in a theatre.

clue.text: Like popular choice of old 'ero carried by airline

indicators.note: carried by means held inside, so one piece sits within the other

parts.note: El Al is the Israeli national airline
Hector, the Trojan hero of old, with his H dropped as the apostrophe shows

explanation.surface: Something resembling the popular vote is borne by an airline for an old-fashioned hero.
explanation.walkthrough: The dropped H in 'ero tells you to drop the H of HECTOR, the hero of Troy.
explanation.definitionFit: Electoral describes an election, the means by which the people make their popular choice.

clue.text: Becoming more grown-up, as opposed to good

parts.note: agin is a dialect word meaning against

explanation.surface: Someone is maturing rather than behaving well.
explanation.definitionFit: Aging is growing older, so becoming more mature in years.

clue.text: Book female author and male explorer put together

parts.note: Katherine Mansfield, the New Zealand short-story writer
Mungo Park, the Scottish explorer of the Niger

explanation.surface: A book compiled jointly by a woman writer and a man who explored.
explanation.definitionFit: Mansfield Park is a novel by Jane Austen, published in 1814.

clue.text: Work on canvas bringing hostility to show'

parts.note: needle is antagonism or ill feeling
to point out is to show or indicate

explanation.surface: An artist's canvas reveals hostility.
explanation.definitionFit: Needlepoint is embroidery stitched onto canvas.

clue.text: Negative reaction sounded, warning for some of the aristocracy

parts.note: no is a negative response
blew means sounded, as a horn or whistle
an omen is a warning sign

explanation.surface: A horn sounded in refusal, a warning to the nobility.
explanation.definitionFit: Noblewomen are female members of the nobility, thus some aristocrats.

clue.text: Cuts lines on graph

definitions.meaning: to axe something is to cut it, as with jobs or spending
the x and y reference lines on a chart

explanation.surface: Someone slashes the lines plotted on a chart.
explanation.definitionFit: Axes is both a verb meaning cuts and the plural of axis, a graph's reference line.

clue.text: Spanish holy man in Texan mission location

definitions.meaning: Saint Anthony, as his name is given in Spanish
the Texas city where the Alamo mission stands

explanation.surface: A Spanish saint is found at the site of a mission in Texas.
explanation.definitionFit: San Antonio is the Spanish name for Saint Anthony, and the Texas city named after him hosts the Alamo mission.

clue.text: Foolishly peel pear without time to ' identify source of fruit

indicators.note: without means outside, so the rearranged letters surround the next piece
foolishly suggests the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone foolishly peels a pear without having time to find where it grew.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Foolishly' shuffles PEEL PEAR into APPLEREE, and 'without' (meaning outside) puts it round T.
explanation.definitionFit: An apple tree is where apples, a kind of fruit, grow.

clue.text: One instructing crew used to appear on the box

definitions.text: used to appear on the box

parts.note: a coach instructs or trains
to man a ship is to crew it

explanation.surface: A trainer who once appeared on television.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the box' looks like television, but it is the coachman's seat on a horse-drawn carriage.
explanation.definitionFit: A coachman drove horse-drawn coaches from a seat called the box, a job of the past.

clue.text: Poet runs into novelist bringing fragrant flower

indicators.note: into means the following pieces are placed inside the novelist

parts.note: Anthony Hope, author of The Prisoner of Zenda
T S Eliot, the poet of The Waste Land
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A poet bumps into a novelist, carrying a sweet-smelling bloom.
explanation.walkthrough: The obvious novelist is George ELIOT, but here Eliot is the poet T S Eliot and the novelist is HOPE.
explanation.definitionFit: Heliotrope is a garden plant prized for its sweet, vanilla-scented purple flowers.

clue.text: Blooming in spring

definitions.meaning: a natural source of water from the ground

explanation.surface: Flowers are out in springtime.
explanation.definitionFit: Well means healthy or flourishing, and a well is also a water source like a spring.

clue.text: Order said, when followed by soldiers, to allay hostility

indicators.note: when followed by means the next piece comes after
order means arrange, so the letters of said are rearranged

parts.note: RM is the Royal Marines

explanation.surface: An order was given, and soldiers followed to calm the conflict.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Order' looks like a command, but it rearranges SAID to DISA.
explanation.definitionFit: To disarm is to calm anger or hostility, as a disarming smile does.

clue.text: One clearly exhibits a widespread view

definitions.text: One clearly exhibits a widespread view

parts.words: One clearly exhibits a widespread view
parts.note: read as a large pane of glass through which a broad panorama is clearly seen, not a popular opinion

explanation.surface: Someone transparently shows an opinion that is widely held.
explanation.definitionFit: A large single-pane window framing a wide outside view is described here.

clue.text: Not prepared to admit female to group

indicators.note: to admit means to let in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a unit is a group

explanation.surface: Someone is not ready to let a woman join the group.
explanation.definitionFit: Unfit means unsuited or not ready for a task.

clue.text: English article seized by Spanish in part of Asia

indicators.note: seized by means held inside the other piece

parts.note: los is a Spanish definite article, the plural of el
a is the English indefinite article

explanation.surface: A piece of English writing has been taken by the Spanish in Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: Laos is a country in Southeast Asia.

clue.text: Man giving a vote precedence as fundamental principle

indicators.note: giving a and vote precedence means they come before Man

parts.note: X is the mark made on a ballot paper
IOM is the Isle of Man

explanation.surface: A man lets a vote come first, as a basic rule.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man' is the Isle of Man, IOM, which goes after A and X.
explanation.definitionFit: An axiom is a self-evident truth taken as a basic principle.

clue.text: Warning sound from gun, crossing a line

indicators.note: crossing means the gun spans the other pieces, holding them inside

parts.note: a firearm is a gun

explanation.surface: A gun goes off as someone crosses a line, raising the alarm.
explanation.definitionFit: A fire alarm is a bell or siren warning of fire.

clue.text: Totally — or just partly

indicators.note: partly means only part of the word is used

explanation.surface: Completely, or only in part.
explanation.definitionFit: All as an adverb means completely, as in all alone.

clue.text: French composer's inclusion of final material

indicators.note: inclusion of means the composer holds the next piece inside

parts.note: Erik Satie, the French composer
nett means final, after all deductions

explanation.surface: A French composer includes material in his last piece.
explanation.definitionFit: Satinette is a thin satin-like fabric, a kind of material.

clue.text: Italian city that's lost nothing in translation

definitions.text: Italian city that's lost nothing in translation

parts.words: Italian city that's lost nothing in translation
parts.note: the city's Italian name ends in O, a nothing, which drops off when it is turned into English

explanation.surface: An Italian city keeps its meaning intact when translated.
explanation.definitionFit: Milan is the English name of Milano, the city in Lombardy, northern Italy.
